## Vengorach (CR 18)

**XP** 153,600  
CE Gargantuan dragon  
**Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +31  


**Defense**


**AC** 34, touch 6, flat-footed 34 (+28 natural, –4 size)  
**hp** 462 (21d12+210)  
**Fort** +21, **Ref** +12, **Will** +13  
**DR** 15/magic; **Immune** fire, paralysis, poison, sleep; **Resist** acid 10; SR 29  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft., fly 120 ft. (poor)  
**Melee** 2 bites +32 (4d6+14/19-20), 2 stings +32 (2d6+14 plus poison)  
**Space** 20 ft.; **Reach** 20 ft.  
**Special Attacks** breath weapon (50-ft. cone, 12d6 fire damage, Reflex DC 29 half, usable every 1d4 rounds)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 38, **Dex** 10, **Con** 29, **Int** 11, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 13  
**Base Atk** +21; **CMB** +39; **CMD** 49  
**Feats** Alertness, Hover, Flyby Attack, Improved Initiative, Vital Strike, Improved Vital Strike, Greater Vital Strike, Improved Critical (bite), Weapon Focus (bite, sting), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Toughness.*  
**Skills** Appraise +24, Fly +14, Intimidate +25, Perception +31, Sense Motive +27, Stealth +12; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception  
**Languages** Draconic  


**Special Abilities**


**Breath Weapon (Su)** Each of vengorach’s heads can breathe fire separately. If their areas overlap, a creature caught in that overlapping area takes a -2 penalty on its Reflex saves. Damage done by both breath weapons stacks and is considered to be a single source of fire damage for the purpose of fire resistance. Regardless of how many heads breathe fire, a vengorach can use its breath weapon once every 1d4 rounds.  

**Poison (Ex)** Sting—injury; save Fort DC 29; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d8 Con; cure 2 consecutive saves. The save DC is Constitution-based.  

**Synchronized Strike (Ex)** Once per round, a vengorach can perform two bite attacks as an attack action, such as when performing a charge or making an attack or opportunity. When a vengorach uses both bite attacks against a creature that is at least one size category smaller than itself, the attacks are resolved as if both heads were flanking the target.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** temperate or warm hills  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** standard
